title: OpenAI 奥特曼称将持续压低 AI 使用价格
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's an economic discussion of how you've priced it or where you've made it available in existing tiers.
segments.zh: 这是关于定价和现有层级可用性的经济讨论。

segments.en: Well, I mean, it is priced higher than other things in the market, but the reason for that is because of the capability and the amount of compute worth putting into this,
segments.zh: 嗯，它的定价确实高于市场上其他产品，但这是因为其能力和所需算力投入。

segments.en: which is why I think it's useful in a new kind of way to hit a new level.
segments.zh: 所以我认为它以新方式达到新水平很有用。

segments.en: You've launched GVT641's sole, like, astrocapability.
segments.zh: 你们推出了GVT641的独特天文能力。

segments.en: And the fifth of the price. But the price is so different. And like, I've been trying to understand, like, what is the big picture story?
segments.zh: 价格只有五分之一，但差异巨大。我一直想理解大局故事。

segments.en: It seems like we're moving towards chief inference at a time where everyone's much more willing to pay for it.
segments.zh: 似乎我们正走向推理主导，而人们更愿意为此付费。

segments.en: Well, how did you arrive at tiers that you've done? I mean, we've talked for a long time about our goal is to make increasingly better intelligence
segments.zh: 那么你是如何确定这些层级的？我们长期讨论目标是让智能越来越好。

segments.en: and to drive the price down and down. And the reason that I think both of those are true is the better you make AI than more people want to use it.
segments.zh: 并不断降低价格。我认为两者都成立，因为AI越好，越多人想用。

segments.en: So people are clearly willing to spend more on AI than ever before, but they want to do so much with it.
segments.zh: 所以人们显然愿意在AI上花更多钱，但他们想用它做更多事。

segments.en: So our belief is that if we continue to drive the quality up and the price down and really leave the parade of frontier at every point on that curve,
segments.zh: 我们相信，如果继续提升质量、降低价格，并始终走在曲线前沿。

segments.en: people will use our tools and tremendous ways. And just even here today, hearing from developers about what they're building with this and what they can do if we continue to drive the price down
